info.title: IAOP Agency Service
info.description: Organizational hierarchy, assignments, transfers, and leadership for the IAOP agency bounded context. All endpoints require a Bearer JWT; organizational scope is enforced per resource.

get.description: Returns agencies visible within the caller organizational scope.

403.description: Outside organizational scope or missing permission

post.description: Creates a top-level agency. Requires platform-administration role and global organizational scope.

403.description: Outside organizational scope or missing permission

get.description: Returns a single agency if inside the caller organizational scope.

post.description: Applies an approved agency lifecycle transition (SUSPEND, REINSTATE, TERMINATE). Requires platform-administration global write scope and optimistic concurrency via expected_version. TERMINATED is terminal; no cascade to units, assignments, or leadership.

post.description: Immediately-effective transfer: ends the current primary assignment and creates the new one plus a transfer record. Caller must hold scope over BOTH source and destination units. Idempotency-Key supported.

EntityId.description:
Stable identifier for domain entities and aggregates.

Wraps a UUIDv7 so identifiers are time-ordered and globally unique
without exposing the raw UUID type throughout the domain model.

Transfer.description: Immutable record of an agent transfer between organizational units.
